Fixes #662

Owner: Dev2 / Written-by: Dev-2

**Label note.** `agent-ready` could not be applied from this account (403); this PR is proposed ahead of the 24 h label window because of the owner's sprint deadline. Claim record: Lead's pickup-ok on #662 — issue comment 6487523184.

## The defect

`ipv6Blocked` (`packages/data-source/src/web/native/url-guard.ts:58-69`) extracted an embedded IPv4 only from a dotted-quad tail. IPv4-mapped and IPv4-compatible IPv6 literals written in hex carry no dots, so they fell through to `return false`; `isBlockedAddress` then reported them as public and `assertPublicUrl` accepted them. `web_fetch` takes a model-supplied URL, so this is the SSRF gate itself, not a downstream check.

## What changes

- Expand the IPv6 literal to its eight hextets (compressed `::` and full form both).
- When the address is IPv4-mapped (80 zero bits, then `ffff`) or IPv4-compatible (96 zero bits), rebuild the dotted quad from the last two hextets and hand it to the existing `ipv4Blocked`.
- `ipv4Blocked` and the existing dotted-quad path are untouched; public IPv6 keeps being accepted.

## Commits

- `b9a10c6b1aac5554c6382bee030156f335de871e` — red tests for the hex mapped/compatible literals and the reverse direction.
- `b3d6112fbb228f3787816a6014f0410882b9240d` — red tests for delegation to the existing IPv4 range table and for the resolver path.
- `fc803262da45092ccc184bc27f9c38c9569db00a` — the guard change above.

No amend, no force-push.

## Tests

`packages/data-source/src/web/native/providers.test.ts`:

- `web_fetch judges IPv4-mapped and IPv4-compatible IPv6 literals by their embedded IPv4` — hex mapped and compatible literals are blocked, including the full eight-hextet spelling; the gate rejects them; the dotted-quad path keeps its behaviour.
- Reverse direction in the same test: public mapped and compatible forms stay unblocked and the gate still accepts them, so the change cannot become an over-block.
- Delegation in the same test: embedded addresses outside the `127/10/192.168` prefixes (carrier-grade NAT, benchmarking) are blocked, proving the judgement is delegated to the existing IPv4 range table rather than re-implemented.
- `web_fetch applies the same judgement to resolved addresses, not only literals` — a resolver returning a mapped literal must reject, so the DNS path stays covered.

Before (red-test commits, on `a074172f`):

```
not ok 1 - web_fetch judges IPv4-mapped and IPv4-compatible IPv6 literals by their embedded IPv4
  error: |-
    false !== true
# pass 0
# fail 1

not ok 2 - web_fetch applies the same judgement to resolved addresses, not only literals
  error: 'Missing expected rejection (PublicUrlError).'
# pass 0
# fail 2
```

After (fix commit):

```
# tests 15
# pass 15
# fail 0
```

## Out of scope

The guard still does not decode embedded IPv4 from NAT64 (`64:ff9b::/96` and `64:ff9b:1::/48`), 6to4 (`2002::/16`), Teredo (`2001::/32`), the IPv4-translated range (`::ffff:0:0:0/96`) or the deprecated site-local range (`fec0::/10`). Those are a separate next fix; this PR does not claim the gate is fully closed.

What this change closes: the two spellings that need no translator to reach a target, namely IPv4-mapped (`::ffff:a.b.c.d` in hex) and IPv4-compatible (`::a.b.c.d` in hex), on both the literal path and the resolved-address path. What it does not close: any address family that only reaches a target through a gateway or translator, listed above. Keeping the judgement delegated to the existing IPv4 range table is what makes the next fix a decoder addition rather than a second policy.

## Validation

Ran:
- `cd packages/data-source && node --import tsx --test src/web/native/providers.test.ts` — **15/15 pass, 0 fail**.
- `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/data-source/tsconfig.json --noEmit` — exit 0.

Not run locally: repository-wide layers (`ci:ut` / `ci:st` / `ci:e2e`), because the pnpm wrapper aborts with `ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY` in this container; this PR's own CI run is the authority for those.

Opening a subagent's detail panel froze the desktop app for three to four seconds on a long run. The whole record was parsed and laid out at once — a closed `<details>` still mounts its children — every tool output went through `react-markdown`, and opening a replayed child re-read the whole roster from the API, though the panel only ever shows one child.

## Render a fold's body on first open

A closed native fold still mounts its subtree, so the panel paid for parsing and laying out tool output, the brief and historical steps that nobody could see. The new `Disclosure` component renders its body when the fold is first opened and keeps it afterwards, so reopening is instant. `open` stays uncontrolled: the browser still owns the open state, which is what lets a running step collapse on its own when it finishes. Running thinking stays open, as before.

## Show tool output as text, not Markdown

Tool input, output and progress are terminal text, not prose. They now render in a `<pre>`; the child's replies and thinking still go through Markdown. This removes the largest Markdown parse in the panel, since tool output is most of a long record's bytes.

## Read one child instead of the roster

`GET /api/sessions/:id/subagents/:sid` returns one child with its steps. The panel uses it when a replayed child is opened; a running child keeps following its own stream. On the server the store clones only that child rather than every child in the session. The roster route remains for callers that list children; the contract table and a contract scenario cover the new route.

A running child is also re-read from that route until it settles, because a wake turn publishes its continuation under a run the panel does not tail. The read returns the whole record, so it pauses while the window is hidden and resumes with one read when the window comes back. If several reads in a row fail, the panel says the record is no longer refreshing instead of looking live while frozen.

## Compare repeated steps by field

`mergeSubagentSteps` used to `JSON.stringify` both copies of every step on every stream tick. `content` can be hundreds of kilobytes, so a step that had not changed was still serialized twice. The comparison is now field by field, with prose compared as the string it is and only the small structured fields going through JSON. The field list is a key set that satisfies `Record<keyof SubagentStep, true>`: a field added to the schema fails the build here instead of being silently ignored. A unit test pins that an unchanged step keeps its identity.

## Visual evidence

The panel after the record is opened, with both folds closed (zh, 1440x900, default 720 px panel):

![opened](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/evidence/pr-854/zh-wide-1-opened.png)

The timeline open, every step still folded, then one tool step open with a long line wrapping inside its box and a failed step whose stack trace keeps its line breaks:

![timeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/evidence/pr-854/zh-wide-3-timeline.png)
![tool step open](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/evidence/pr-854/zh-wide-4-tool-open.png)
![stack trace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/evidence/pr-854/zh-wide-5-stack-trace.png)

The same states at the panel's minimum width (480 px) and in English:

![narrow panel, English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/evidence/pr-854/en-narrow-4-tool-open.png)

Every state — just opened, task open, timeline open with folded rows, one tool step open, failed step with a stack trace, running vs finished thinking — is captured in Chinese and English at 1440x900 with the default panel and at the 480 px minimum. Index: [README](https://github.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/blob/evidence/pr-854/README.md). Uncut recordings, about 39 s each, driving the same states: [Chinese](https://github.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/blob/evidence/pr-854/panel-walkthrough-zh.webm), [English](https://github.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/blob/evidence/pr-854/panel-walkthrough-en.webm).

## Validation

The measurement is committed as `apps/desktop/e2e/panel-performance.spec.ts`. It builds a 137-step record of 15 KB per step (about 2 MB), opens it in the browser, and prints click-to-visible and the longest main-thread task. Run one worker, alone:

```
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.e2e/browsers \
  apps/desktop/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright test \
  --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts \
  apps/desktop/e2e/panel-performance.spec.ts
```

| Tree | Click to visible | Longest main-thread task | Long tasks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `3fc77a3f0d` (reviewed base) | 3850 / 3902 / 3926 / 4120 ms | 2803 / 2835 / 2793 / 2882 ms | 2 |
| `5a80ef65` | 502 / 504 / 521 ms | 0 ms | 0 |
| `1677180f` (this head) | 520 ms | 0 ms | 0 |

On the base tree the same spec also fails its mount assertion: 137 step rows are in the DOM while every fold is closed. On this head it passes. Under parallel load (beside the whole panel suite) click-to-visible rises — 5010 ms in one such run — while the longest main-thread task stays at 0 ms; the long task is the felt freeze, and wall clock under shared CPU is not a stable number, which is why the E2E test asserts the mount state and only budgets 15 s for visibility.

Desktop unit tests: 720 passed, 0 failed. Desktop `tsc` and the workspace `pnpm typecheck` pass. The panel suite (`panel-interactions.spec.ts` + `panel-performance.spec.ts`) passes 13/13.

UT layer (`pnpm ci:ut`): planned 6168, executed 6139, passed 6125, failed 14, skipped 0.

The 29 planned-but-unexecuted tests carry `swarm:required`. They are not a gap in this change's coverage: the JiuwenSwarm toolchain could not install on this host, so the harness left those entries out of the worker plans. 20 are in `services/api/src/server.test.ts` (gateway/model naming, title refinement, queued runs, approval switching, timeouts, MCP literature flow) and 9 in `services/api/src/run-cancel.test.ts` (usage, Reviewer stop, blocked-run queueing and cancellation, child-stream endpoint, stuck-run stop).

The 14 failures, run against `3fc77a3f0d` with the same command on both trees:

| File | This head | `3fc77a3f0d` | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `services/launcher/src/serve.test.ts` | 5 failed / 26 passed | 5 failed / 26 passed | owned-sidecar startup in this sandbox |
| `services/launcher/src/source-evolve.test.ts` | 5 failed / 3 passed | 5 failed / 3 passed | owned-sidecar startup in this sandbox |
| `services/runner/src/sandbox-network.test.ts` | 1 failed / 7 passed | 1 failed / 7 passed | `bwrap: Unknown option --disable-userns` |
| `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-agent.test.ts` | 1 failed / 109 passed | 1 failed / 109 passed | trajectory event order from the unavailable Swarm toolchain |
| `scripts/race-contract.test.mjs` | 1 failed under the harness, passes standalone | same | harness `spawnSync ETIMEDOUT` |
| `check:research-python-ut` | 1 failed under the harness, passes standalone | same | harness environment at run time; `run-research-python.sh unit` now exits 0 on both trees |

ST layer (`pnpm ci:st`): planned 51, executed 51, passed 49, failed 2, skipped 0. One failure downloads a pinned Evolve runtime (`fetch-runtime.mjs`) and the network transfer fails; the other is `check:swarm-sdk-contract`, blocked on the JiuwenSwarm toolchain install on this host. The 11 integration files of the layer itself passed.

E2E layer, local (`pnpm ci:e2e`, mocked browser subset, `CI_E2E_BACKEND=legacy`): planned 133, executed 133, passed 95, failed 38, skipped 0. Run with the legacy backend because the default JiuwenSwarm backend cannot install its toolchain here (network-throttled `uv sync`).

## E2E user journeys

FAIL, with counts — local mocked run on `5a80ef65` (the full layer was not re-run for the last two commits; the panel specs were, and pass on `2820d223`), `CI_E2E_BACKEND=legacy`: 95/133 passed, 38 failed. By project:

| Project | Passed | Failed | What failed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mocked-standard | 90 | 12 | 2 require the real Jiuwen backend, 1 is blocked on Swarm, 9 are web-view assertions unrelated to the subagent panel |
| mocked-literature | 0 | 6 | all `BLOCKED: requires real Swarm` |
| mocked-research | 0 | 20 | 16 `BLOCKED: requires real Swarm`, 4 require an isolated Swarm stack |
| mocked-governed | 5 | 0 | — |

BLOCKED — the default JiuwenSwarm E2E backend, because `scripts/jiuwenswarm.sh setup` cannot complete on this host. No subagent-panel spec failed; `apps/desktop/e2e/panel-interactions.spec.ts` and `panel-performance.spec.ts` passed 11/11 on this tree.

The GitHub Actions L2 mocked jobs (standard-config, standard-journeys, literature, research, governed) all passed on the previous head in run [41860884616](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41860884616); the new head is re-running them.

## Release

Release category: `release:performance`
User impact: a subagent's detail panel opens immediately on long runs; the timeline still shows the same steps and content, with folded bodies appearing when opened.
Compatibility and migration: none.

recent_merged.author: qingkwl
recent_merged.body:
## 概述

Windows 桌面端安装包体积优化 + 6 个 Python env → 2 个的合并。中文设计/决策记录见 #807，English version: #808。

**体积口径（实测与投影分列，不把投影当实测）**

| | 安装包 | 口径 |
|---|---|---|
| f26 基线 | 797.6 MiB | 实测 |
| W1 之后 | 613.4 MiB | 实测 |
| W2 之后 | 583.3 MiB | 实测 |
| W4 之后 | **578.0 MiB** | **实测（−27.5%）** |
| 停止清扫 babel 之后 | **583.6 MiB** | **投影（−26.8%），未实测** |

最后一行是投影。它的两个输入都是实测的：578.0 MiB 实际产物 + babel 经 LZMA2 `-mx9` 压缩后 5.60 MiB（本机 7-Zip 26.01 重测；未压缩 29.38 MiB，其中 `locale-data` 占 28.50 MiB = 97.0%，按未压缩数字报收益会高估 5.2 倍）。

**更正上一版正文（我自己写错、reviewer 已据其回复，在此一并收回）**：上一版说这行是投影"因为构建机 C 盘只剩 2.4 GB，低于 `MIN_FREE_BYTES` 的 5 GB 门禁，`pnpm dist` 在这台机器上跑不起来"。这个理由是错的——`MIN_FREE_BYTES`（`win_desktop/src/wizard-data-dir.ts:8`）是**首启数据目录向导**的运行时门槛，`build.mjs` 与 `assemble-backend.mjs` 里**没有任何** free-space 检查，且构建产物全部落在 E 盘（实测 142 GB 可用），C 盘余量与能否出包无关。真实情况是：我此前把运行时门槛误当成构建门槛，并据此把唯一阻断项（真机证据）搁置了十几个小时。更正后实测了构建链，撞到的真阻断是**路径长度**而不是磁盘空间：`compileall` 把 `.pyc` 先写成 `<name>.pyc.<id(path)>` 再改名（后缀**长度** 14 字符是实测：本机 `compile_dir` 编 40 个文件，40/40 个临时名的后缀都是 13 位数字加前导点；那次运行的 pid 是 `23144`、只有 5 位，所以后缀不是 pid——早先正文写的 `<pid>` 是错的机制标签，数字本身没错），那 14 字符后缀配上 A5 实测的 `maxRel=192`，在长构建根下是 60+192+14=**266**，超过 Windows 的 259 可用字符，于是 JW venv 预编译以 `FileNotFoundError` 失败（正是本 PR 新加的"预编译硬失败"门禁把它拦下来了）。改走短构建根后是 12+192+14=218，余量 41；release5 当初也是这么构建的（`release5-assemble.log:3` 记 `out = X:\p5`）。同一算术在 electron-builder 那一层也成立且更紧：payload 会被拷进 `<output>\win-unpacked\resources\…`，仓库内默认的 `win_desktop\release`（62 字符）算下来是 62+14+192=**268**，同样超限，短输出目录 240 才装得下——A5 门禁只管 payload 根、没覆盖这层拷贝。代码里的 `COMPILEALL_TEMP_MARGIN = 19`（`assemble-backend.mjs:957`）与这里的实测 14 是同一个量，差 5 是**故意的**：19 是保守上界，`id()` 的十进制位数不是契约，取宽只会让 A5 更严不会更松；反过来按「14 是实测」去把常量改成 14，会朝不安全的那一侧收紧余量，请勿这么做。出包与实测数字随后回填。唯一与 C 盘余量真实相关的，是壳单测里 `probeDataDir: real writable dir with disk space passes` 这一项（它量的就是那个 5 GB 运行时门槛）。

硬约束全程保持：**离线双击即用、首启零网络、首启不变慢**（W15 全量 pyc 预编译不触碰，且 assemble 现对预编译失败硬失败）。

## 波次（每波独立出包验证）

| 波 | 内容 | 安装包 |
|---|---|---|
| W1 | JW 死重清除（extras 收口 ~238 MB / lint 组 / k8s·onnx·adk 传递依赖 / codex vendor 原生工具链剔除 ~437 MB）+ JW patch 0018（playwright/uv 移出主依赖） | 613.4 MiB |
| W2 | 5 服务 venv → uv workspace 单 venv（统一 lock 68 包就高：fastapi 0.162 / pydantic 2.14） | 583.3 MiB |
| W3 | JW patch 0019 版本对齐；硬链接去重经实测证伪后关闭（7z 窗口机制 + venv 隔离，见 issue 正文） | — |
| W4 | assemble 四道门禁（JW 预编译硬失败 / 载荷 import 自证 / RequiredFiles 清单 / 尺寸常显）+ Electron locales 55→3 pak | 578.0 MiB |

**W3 的 websockets 口径**（上一版正文在这里前后不一致，现按 lock 文件重述）：

- 仓库根 `uv.lock` 解析到 `websockets 17.4`（`uv.lock:1802-1803`），准入它的 member 要求是 `specifier = ">=12.0"`（`:1383`）。根 lock 里**没有** `google-genai`（`grep -c` = 0），`services/launcher/src/evolve-lock.ts:692` 也已是 `websockets==17.4`，与根 lock 一致。
- **更正上一版正文**：上一版写"patch 0019 只改 specifier 文本、没有重 resolve"是错的，在此收回。0019 改了 specifier（`>=12.0,<16` → `>=12.0,<18`，patch 第 9-10、347-348 行）**并重跑了 `uv lock`**：patch 内含 +100 / −83 行 `upload-time`（PyPI 毫秒级时间戳，人写不出）与 numpy `2.4.6`/`2.5.4`、pandas `3.1.0` 的版本迁移，是重 resolve 的产物而非手改文本。
- 生成方式（补 reviewer 要的命令）：在 JW 源码树 `.sciencediscovery-data/jiuwenswarm/src/`（tag `workswarm0.2.6` + 补丁应用态）改 `pyproject.toml` 后跑 `uv lock`（uv 0.11.16），再 `git diff` 出 `0019-align-workspace-versions.patch`。知识库此前只记"lock 重生成"四字、未记命令，是记录缺口，本次补齐。
- JW lock 里 websockets 仍停在 **15.0.1**，**不是**因为没重 resolve，而是 `google-genai 1.73.1` 钉了 `websockets<17.0,>=13.0.0`（实证：该包 dist-info `METADATA:28` = `Requires-Dist: websockets<17.0,>=13.0.0`；JW venv 实装的是 `websockets-15.0.1.dist-info`）。0019 放宽的 `<18` cap 高于 17，够不着这条约束，所以重 resolve 后 JW 侧仍解析到 15.0.1。
- 上面提到的 JW lock 是 `.sciencediscovery-data/jiuwenswarm/src/uv.lock` —— 那是**构建时生成的树，reviewer 打不开**，所以把 stanza 内联在此（`:5503-5507`）：

```toml
[[package]]
name = "websockets"
version = "15.0.1"
source = { registry = "https://pypi.org/simple" }
sdist = { url = "https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/21/e6/26d09fab466b7ca9c7737474c52be4f76a40301b08362eb2dbc19dcc16c1/websockets-15.0.1.tar.gz", hash = "sha256:82544de02076bafba038ce055ee6412d68da13ab47f0c60cab827346de828dee", size = 177016, upload-time = "2025-03-05T20:03:41.606Z" }
```

  对照根 lock 的 websockets（`uv.lock:1802-1805`，仓库内文件，reviewer 可直接看）：

```toml
[[package]]
name = "websockets"
version = "17.4"
source = { registry = "https://pypi.org/simple" }
sdist = { url = ".../websockets-17.4.tar.gz", hash = "sha256:09d3939b70df0c8ad2da145ebd50978bccaee1d565e838b0e7921a34d38571eb", size = 191391, upload-time = "2026-10-30T15:10:35.873Z" }
```

- **回答 reviewer 的"是否还有约束把 websockets 钉在 17.4 以下"**：两个 lock 答案不同，分开说。**根 lock 里没有任何 cap** —— 全部 websockets 引用只有 `:1367`、`:1715` 两处裸 `{ name = "websockets" }` 和 `:1383` 一处 `specifier = ">=12.0"`，17.4 是无上界的自由解析结果，这是**有意的**：根 workspace 的 5 个服务都不含 google-genai（`grep -c google-genai uv.lock` = 0），没有任何东西需要迁就。**JW lock 里有 cap**，就是上面那条 google-genai 的 `<17.0`。所以"根 = 17.4 无 cap / JW = 15.0.1 被 google-genai 钉住"两句都成立，上一版把它们写成互相矛盾是因为没标明是两个不同项目的锁文件。

补丁链 manifest：**14 → 17**（base 树 14 个 `.patch`，本分支新增 `0018-desktop-slim-deps` / `0019-align-workspace-versions` / `0020-lazy-observability-import`；实测 `git ls-tree` base=`89cd2d30` 与 head 对比）。上一版正文写的"13 → 16"两头都错。

## 评审改了什么（这些在评审前都已作为回归或 no-op 发布过，现各有测试或构建门禁钉住）

- **babel 曾被当作死重清扫，静默降级了成品的 HTML 压缩器。** 那条规则的理由写的是"jinja2 硬依赖"，但 JW venv 里**根本没装 jinja2**，规则引用了一个不存在的包。真实链路是 `openjiuwen/html_compressor.py:55`（惰性、无保护的 `import_module("trafilatura")`）→ trafilatura → courlan → **模块作用域**导入 babel（`courlan/filters.py:11`）。`compress()` 吞掉 `ModuleNotFoundError` 并回退 beautifulsoup，所以它**无报错、无日志、exit 0**地发布了，只是每次 HTML 压缩的 title/author/date 全为 None。规则已删除，探针断言 4 改跑产品自己的压缩器，extractor 不是 `"trafilatura"` 就让构建失败。另外"删 `babel/locale-data` 省字节"也实测证伪：`Locale.parse` 会对**每个**合法 locale 抛 `FileNotFoundError`，而 courlan `filters.py:185` 的 `except (TypeError, UnknownLocaleError)` 接不住——把静默降级变成崩溃。
- **两个安装目录守卫用 `Abort` 取消，实际不取消。** `Abort` 在 custom page **creator** 里只是"跳过本页"，向导照旧推进到 InstFiles 并装进用户刚拒绝的目录，而 MessageBox 文案说会返回目录页。改为 `Quit`；又因为 custom page creator 里的裸 `Quit` 退出码是 **0**（实测矩阵：`.onInit` 裸 Quit = 2，page creator 裸 Quit = 0，页面位置不影响），两处各加 `SetErrorLevel 1`，使无人值守场景下"被拒绝的安装"不再报告成功。
- **codex vendor 清扫曾指向扁平化产不出来的路径，437 MB 的收益是 no-op。** 现枚举全部可达形态，且**下探不受名字门控**——平台包赢得 primaryOf 时会把 wrapper 嵌到 `@openai/codex-sdk` 下，受门控的遍历永远进不去。重放 `primaryOf` 实测：wrapper-primary 顺序 7 个 location 条目 → 2 个 distinct 目录，旧的门控遍历找到 2/2（这正是缺口在那次构建里存活的原因）；platform-primary 顺序 → 3 个 distinct，门控遍历只找到 1/3。
- **A1b 探针曾只证明"留下的还能用"，规则静默失配时门禁照样全绿。** 现增加断言 5 强制包表（`onnxruntime`/`kubernetes` 必须 ABSENT，`babel`/`courlan`/`trafilatura`/`chromadb`/`openjiuwen` 必须 PRESENT）；默认 EF 的 `works` 在 payload 模式下不再是合法结果；codex vendor 清扫另有一道**按内容**（`codex-package.json`）而非按名字的独立复查——复查若复用清扫自己的名字正则就会在正则失配时一起失明。
- `nsh-syntax-check` 的第三档 PATH 发现曾是死代码：裸 `catch {}` 连 `execFileSync` 未导入的 `ReferenceError` 一起吞掉，把编程错误报成"makensis not found"。现只白名单两种实测的 not-on-PATH 形态。
- 安装根与数据目录分离（两者曾默认同一字面量，卸载会删掉 `envs/`、`secrets/` 和全部会话），路径检查改为平台无关（`win32.isAbsolute` + `win32.parse`）。

## 质量证据

**在当前 head `0ad6e15a` 重跑的**（tree `edb770d2`）

- 壳单测：**159 项 / 159 pass / 0 fail**。上一版正文写的是"158 pass / 1 fail，唯一 fail 是 `probeDataDir: real writable dir with disk space passes`"——那一项现已通过（C 盘当前 14 GB 可用，高于它自身 5 GB 的 `MIN_FREE_BYTES` 运行时门槛）。需要说明的是：这个门槛是**首启数据目录向导**的运行时检查，**不是构建门禁**；上一版把它误当成"构建跑不起来"的理由，已在上方更正段收回。（更早一版正文写"118/118"，是旧 head 的旧数字。）
- typecheck：本 head 实测 `win_desktop`（`tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`）= exit 0 / 0 error，根 `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` = exit 0 / 0 error。`npm run typecheck` 的完整命令（`pnpm --recursive typecheck` 逐包）在本机受沙箱 `wmic` 拦截跑不起来，但 CI 的 `L1 static checks` 已覆盖它且此前为 success。本 PR 改的 `scripts/start-stack.{sh,mjs}` 不是 `.ts`、不在任何 tsc 覆盖范围，故类型层零影响。（注：裸跑根 `tsconfig.json` 会报数千条 error，那是它把 `apps/desktop/e2e-real` 等自带 tsconfig 的 e2e 规格一并拉进来所致，**不是** `npm run typecheck` 的命令、也不是 CI 的口径。）
- `nsh-syntax-check`：exit 0，`installer.nsh` 编译干净，产物 95.4 KiB，7 warnings / 0 unexpected / 0 error line。
- CI：本次 force-push（`0ad6e15a`）已重新触发，`Select CI policy` = success、`L1 static checks` 与 `CodeCheck(GitCode)` 正在跑，结果随后回填。**rebase 前那次完整运行**是 17 个 check、13 success + 4 skipped（按 policy）、0 failed，必需项 `merge-gate` = success（success：L1 static / UT / ST / L2 mocked×5 / Freeze matrix / Coverage / CodeCheck / Select CI policy / merge-gate；skipped：Binary release / Docker image / L3 / L4-L5 real E2E，均由 `Select CI policy` 按事件类型跳过，非失败）。

**在更早的 head `6a852bd6` 上实测、本 head 未逐项重跑的**（探针三棵树、变异注入、全链冒烟、签名/blockmap/locales）：从 `6a852bd6`（tree `8b46e690`）到当前 head `0ad6e15a`（tree `edb770d2`），tree 的差异经 `git diff --name-only` 核实只有两类，共 **14 个文件 / +720 −30**——① rebase onto upstream/main 带进来的 10 个 `apps/web/**` 文件，那是上游自己的改动、已在 main 上评审并 CI 绿，且不落在本 PR 拥有的 payload/JW/build/sweep 任何路径上；② F14 + F15 修复的 3 个文件（`scripts/start-stack.sh`、`scripts/start-stack.mjs`、新增 `scripts/start-stack-lock.test.mjs`），只动 dev-stack 启动器与其测试；③ F17 的 `win_desktop/scripts/assemble-backend.mjs` **+2/−1 全是注释行**（A5 预算注释块内，`COMPILEALL_TEMP_MARGIN` 仍是 19），无任何可执行行变化。所以上述探针与清扫证据对它当时所测的代码路径依然成立；变了的只有启动器，而它已由新加的 `start-stack-lock` 测试（**7 项 / 7 pass**，其中 4 项是变异守卫、且每一项都实测过还原旧代码后确实变红）单独钉住——注意它**不在**下方 159 项里，159 是 `win_desktop/test/*.test.ts` 的范围，`scripts/` 下的这个文件由 CI 的 `ut` job（ubuntu）跑。

- 探针在**三棵真实树**上：babel 回归 payload → exit 1 且点名 babel；dev tree 默认 → exit 1 点名 onnxruntime+kubernetes；dev tree + `SD_PROBE_DEV_TREE=1` → exit 0 PROBE_OK。
- 变异注入 **6/6 CAUGHT**（安装器守卫 3 个 + 清扫复查 3 个），每次验证 tree 还原 byte-identical 后 clean re-run 绿。
- 每波全链冒烟：adapter `/agent/info` reachable；assemble 四查全绿。
- 成品：签名 ✅ blockmap ✅ locales = en-US/zh-CN/zh-TW ✅；JW pyc 全量预编译。

**上一版正文的"载荷抽查：审计死重 7/7 不在"已作废**：那个分母把 babel 算作死重，而 babel 现在是**必须保留**的活包。当前门禁的可复核口径是探针的 `NEVER_PRESENT`（2 项）+ `ALWAYS_PRESENT`（5 项），且两者都是**断言**而非打印。

**明确未在本 head 复验、写出来省得猜**：evolve 的 33 个失败仍是 Windows 无沙箱的既有基线（产过 artifact，但未在此重跑 base-vs-head 同命令对照）；按 yuanzhou75 最新清单，这一项已被豁免为非阻断，本 PR **不再声称**做过"逐项零回归"（详见下方"尚缺的验证"）。哪些下游 consumer 在合并 lock 之后重跑过，记录在各波原始 commit message 里（现已 squash，可从备份 tag 读到全部逐波 message，见下方"回退"），未在此重新推导。

## 回退

本分支已按 maintainer 要求 squash 成**单个 commit**（`0ad6e15a`，由 25 个逐波 commit squash 而来，含 rebase 后的 F14/F15/F17 修复），所以"每波独立 revert"不再成立——回退单位是整个 PR。需要单独回退某波时：

- 补丁链 `0018`/`0019`/`0020` 可各自 `git apply --reverse`。
- **squash 本身是零内容变更的**：`git reset --soft` 到 upstream/main 后单次 `git commit`，得到的 tree 与 squash 前的 2-commit head `4d0cf516` 逐字节相同（tree `0c8582b3`）。`4d0cf516` 在 force-push 后仍可通过 GitHub API / 网页 commit 页读到（**不能** `git fetch origin 4d0cf516`，实测报 `couldn't find remote ref`；可复核的是下面这条）：`gh api repos/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/commits/4d0cf516 -q .commit.tree.sha` → `0c8582b3...`，等于 squash 那一版 head 的 tree。随后 review 提出 **F15**（start-stack.sh 镜像路径被 Ctrl-C 打断后根 `uv.lock` 留脏、备份不还原），修在了同一个 commit 里，所以当前 head 的 tree（`edb770d2`）与 `4d0cf516` **相差恰好 review 三条 finding 的 4 个文件**（`git diff --numstat 4d0cf516 HEAD`：`start-stack-lock.test.mjs` +196/−8、`start-stack.mjs` +52/−14、`start-stack.sh` +52/−2、`assemble-backend.mjs` +2/−1，合计 +302/−25）。payload / JW / sweep / installer **任何行为都没动**（`assemble-backend.mjs` 那 3 行是注释），所以上面所有体积与门禁的实测数字仍然描述成品，变的只有 dev-stack 启动器和它的测试。
- 更早的 24 个逐波 commit（rebase 与 F14/F15 之前）的 head 是 `6a852bd6`（tree `8b46e690`，同样只能经 API/网页读，不能按 SHA fetch）；它与当前 head **相差 14 个文件 / +720 −30**——rebase 带进来的 10 个 `apps/web/**` 加上 F14/F15 的 3 个 `scripts/*` 加上 F17 的 `assemble-backend.mjs`。这 24 条逐波 message 已转录进当前单 commit 的 message 末尾。（本地另存了 `backup/pr834-before-squash2-*` 与 `backup/pr834-before-squash-*` 两个 tag 指向 `4d0cf516`、`6a852bd6`，纯属本机便利，不作为可复核证据；可复核的是上面两个 SHA 经 API 的读法。）

## 尚缺的验证（按 yuanzhou75 2026-11-05 的清单收敛）

上一版这段写的是"在这台机器上无法产出（同一磁盘空间原因）"——理由同样是上面已更正的那个假门槛，收回。构建链已跑通，以下按 reviewer 缩减后的要求列出，不再声称需要"双语全套截图 + 录屏"：

reviewer 的原文口径是：三档路径计时/双语全套截图/30-60 秒录屏**"要求偏重，可以缩减，不必全部完成"**；真实 Windows 安装验证**不建议完全豁免**，但"至少应完成一次干净机器安装→首启，并实际触发超长路径拒绝和卸载保留数据。截图/简短文字记录即可"；evolve 的 33 个既有失败逐项对照**可豁免**，"只要不继续声称已经完成逐项零回归即可"。据此本段收敛为三项待回填：

1. 一次干净机器安装 → 首启，含首启计时（对照 f26 基线），截图或简短文字记录。
2. 实际触发超长路径拒绝对话框：它说什么、点确定后是回到目录页还是中止安装（`installer.nsh:281-289` 的注释说第一版会在用户已拒绝后再次中止，这正是要用一次真实点击了结的失效模式）。
3. 卸载页的"是否保留用户数据"分支各走一次。

关于 evolve：本 PR **不再声称**做过"与 f26 基线树逐一对照零回归"。事实是这 33 个失败在 Windows 无沙箱环境下是既有基线、CI 已绿，但 base-vs-head 同命令逐项名字对照**没有做过**；按 reviewer 的豁免，此项不再列为交付，也不再以任何形式声称已完成。

yuanzhou75 的 "Still open 2"（清扫仍只有静态 import 扫描作依据）**已由 A1b 探针回应**：他要求的"在清扫后的环境上跑 runtime check——通过 chroma 路径写入并查询一条 memory-graph 项，并证明默认 embedding fallback 要么可用要么给出可读错误"正是 `scripts/probe-payload-runtime.py` 现在做的事，并已接进 assemble 作为构建门禁（详见上方"评审改了什么"与对应 review thread 的回复）。

剩余可选杠杆待拍板：evolve candidates extra（−~25 MiB）、飞书 `lark_oapi`、`imageio_ffmpeg`/`matplotlib` 审计。

recent_merged.body: The in-app feedback path only existed as a proposal: nothing collected what a user saw when something broke, so every report started from "it does not work". This wires the whole chain for the web and desktop front ends: a dialog that captures kind, description, frequency and impact (both required, since a report without them cannot be triaged), a draft/history store, and a receipt code the user can quote. The report is relayed by a Cloudflare Worker into a private GitHub issue, with KV-backed dedupe, per-IP and per-install rate limits and a daily quota so the endpoint cannot be used as a spam funnel. Payload building, redaction, PII detection and the receipt format live in operational-logging so both apps and the tests share one contract, and the offline screen seeds the dialog with the failure's diagnostics so a "cannot reach the local service" report arrives with boot state, origin and user agent already attached. /kind feature **What does this PR do / why do we need it**: - `packages/operational-logging/src/feedback.ts`: the shared contract — payload building, field validation, redaction, PII detection, contact classification and receipt generation, imported by both clients and the Worker so the wire format cannot drift. - `packages/feedback-worker`: a Cloudflare Worker that relays a submission into a private GitHub issue (labels `source:in-app`, `kind:`, `needs-triage`, `contact:`), with KV-backed dedupe keyed by reporter and content, a per-IP hourly limit, a per-install daily limit, a daily issue quota, a CORS allowlist, and a 422 fallback that retries without labels so a repository missing a label does not lose the report. - `apps/web` and `apps/desktop`: the same dialog (kind, description, frequency, impact — frequency and impact mandatory), a draft and a 50-entry history in `localStorage`, the receipt display, a 我要反馈 entry in the desktop sidebar footer, and an entry on the offline screen that pre-fills the failure's diagnostics. - i18n in `apps/web/src/i18n/messages.ts` and in both desktop dictionaries (`text/zh.ts`, `text/en.ts`). **Which issue(s) this PR fixes**: Closes #844 **What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**： - Unit tests: `operational-logging` 12 cases, `feedback-worker` 12 cases (CORS, 16 KiB rejection, invalid JSON and wrong field types, success path, duplicate within the window, per-install 429, daily quota 503, GitHub 5xx surfacing 502 without leaking the token, reporter-scoped dedupe, 422 label fallback), plus 8 + 8 status-code mapping and 7 + 7 store cases in the two clients. - Suites: web 248 pass / desktop 86 pass; `tsc --noEmit` clean for the shared package, the Worker and both apps. - Manual end-to-end against the deployed Worker: desktop dialog → receipt `FB-775M-N8A8` shown and recorded in 我的反馈; local backend stopped → reload lands on the offline screen → 我要反馈 (description pre-filled, diagnostics expandable, `boot: offline (unreachable)`) → receipt `FB-XKXW-FGSZ`; backend restarted → 重试 recovers in one click. - Behaviour checks: 提交 stays disabled until frequency and impact are chosen, with the reason shown; the same content from the same install returns the original receipt instead of opening a second issue; a full-length description still carries the two mandatory triage lines. Known gap: the mandatory-field rule has no component-level test yet — it is covered by the manual verification above. The plan is to extract the form-state predicate into a shared pure function and assert it from both apps. **Self-checklist**: + - [x] **Design**: Has the solution corresponding to the PR been reviewed by the Maintainer, and have all review comments been replied to and revised + - [x] **Test**: Has the code in the PR been fully covered by UT/ST test cases, and have the newly added test cases been uploaded to the repository along with this PR or already uploaded. + - [x] **Verification**: Does the PR description contains a detailed description of the verification results regarding the achievement of the expected goals for the Feature, Refactor, and Bugfix to this PR. + - [x] **Interface**: Does it involve changes to external interfaces? The corresponding changes have been approved by the interface review organization, and the annotation information for the API has been correctly refreshed. + - [x] **Document**: Does it involve modifications to the official website documentation? If so, please submit the materials to the Doc repository in a timely manner. ## Visual evidence (desktop app) Drag each image from `feedback-ui/` onto the line marked for it (the uploader inserts the link in place). Order matches the list requested in review. 1. Sidebar footer — 我要反馈 to the right of the GitHub star 2. The dialog on open, nothing filled in 3. The gate — description typed, 出现频率 / 影响程度 still unselected: 提交 stays disabled and the reason is shown 4. After submitting — receipt `FB-4SET-7JJR` 5. 我的反馈 after one submission — the same receipt is stored 6. Offline screen — 我要反馈 pre-fills the failure, diagnostics collapsed and expanded 7. English UI — dialog and receipt state A 30–60 s recording of the end-to-end flow is not attached yet; it is being prepared and will follow on this PR.

Fixes #885

## What this fixes

In an `zh-CN` session a tool card mixed two languages inside one frame: `输入` came from the message catalog, and the headings immediately below it — `Result`, `Error`, `Created files`, `Produced artifacts` — were English literals minted by the parser. The copy button inherited the English half, so its accessible label read `复制Result`.

The parser keeps its English labels on purpose: `parseToolResultSections` output is read by the existing parser test and is the value the per-section copy button copies, so translating there would change a contract to fix a rendering defect. The locale is applied where the card renders instead, in `apps/web/src/timeline/ToolIoSections.tsx`:

- `Result` / `Error` reuse `timeline.result` / `timeline.error`, the two keys that already existed in the catalog and had no caller — the wiring was simply never finished.
- `Created files` / `Produced artifacts` get `timeline.createdFiles` / `timeline.producedArtifacts`, added in both `en` and `zh-CN`.
- `stdout` / `stderr` are left verbatim in every locale: they are protocol stream names, not prose.

## Red first

`apps/web/tests/tool-result-labels.test.tsx` on base `89cd2d30`, before the fix:

```
$ cd apps/web && node --import tsx --test tests/tool-result-labels.test.tsx
not ok 1 - USG-021 tool result headings follow the reader's locale
  error: |-
    Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
    + actual - expected

      [
        '输入',
    +   'Result'
    -   '结果'
      ]
# tests 1
# pass 0
# fail 1
```

The first heading in that diff is already `输入`, so the failure is the untranslated headings and nothing about the harness. The test covers all four headings, both locales, the failed-run case, the copy labels (`复制结果` / `复制错误`, and no `复制Result`), and the two verbatim stream names.

## After

```
# tests 1
# pass 1
# fail 0
```

## Gates, all on the pushed tip `d4c482be637952fd1c05b67d3acd0890ea208e27`

Ran:

- `pnpm --recursive typecheck` → exit 0
- `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` → exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web test` → `# tests 1216 / # pass 1216 / # fail 0`, exit 0 (new test is `ok 1181 - USG-021`; the existing `tool-result-sections.test.tsx` parser contract is unchanged and still green)
- `CI_E2E_PREPARED=1 pnpm ci:l1` → `{"status":"PASS","planned":4,"executed":4,"passed":4,"failed":0,"skipped":0}`, exit 0

Not run: the L2/ST profiles beyond L1 locally (the change is a rendered string, no flow), and CodeCheck on the GitCode mirror, which runs upstream.

## Diff, base `89cd2d30`

```text
 apps/web/src/i18n/messages.ts              |  4 +++
 apps/web/src/timeline/ToolIoSections.tsx   | 26 ++++++++++++++++++++--
 apps/web/tests/tool-result-labels.test.tsx | 70 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 3 files changed, 97 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
```

Commits keep the red/green pairing: `6c7d12c5` test (red), `d4c482be` fix.

Release category: release:fix
User impact: in `zh-CN` the tool card's section headings and its copy labels are Chinese (`结果` / `错误` / `创建的文件` / `生成的文件`, `复制结果`), matching `输入` above them; the English UI is unchanged and `stdout`/`stderr` stay verbatim in both.
Compatibility and migration: none — the parser's labels and the copy payload are untouched.

Fixes #860

A compact token count rounds **before** it decides which unit to print, so `999_999` tokens become `${Math.round(999.999)}K` = `1000K` — a number that reads as a million while the exported field still says `999999`. The chart-axis formatter has the same shape (`999_999` → `1000.0K`). One threshold check is off by the unit boundary, not by one token.

## What changed

- `formatCompactTokenValue` crosses into `M` when the thousands rendering would round to `1000` (`Math.round(value / 1_000) >= 1_000`), so `999_500…999_999` print `1.0M` instead of `1000K`. Values that still round below that (`999_499` → `999K`) keep the existing behaviour, as do `10_000` → `10K` and `1_000_000` → `1.0M`.
- `formatChartNumber` applies the same boundary to its one-decimal thousands label (`999.9K` stays `999.9K`, `999_999` becomes `1.0M`, never `1000.0K`), so an axis tick cannot claim a unit the data has not reached.
- `formatTokenField` and every export path are untouched: the exported value is still the exact integer, which is what made the mismatch visible.

## Validation

Red first, on `89cd2d30`:
- `apps/web/tests/UsagePage.test.tsx` — `# tests 5 / # pass 4 / # fail 1`; `not ok 2 - USG-031 a compact token count never rounds up into a unit it has not reached`, `expected: '1.0M'`, `actual: '1000K'`.
- After the fix: `# tests 5 / # pass 5 / # fail 0`.

Gates at tip `4744e536a58db31678518007b2e8709adef51776`:
- `pnpm --recursive typecheck` → exit 0
- `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` → exit 0
- `pnpm ci:l1` → exit 0, `{"status":"PASS","planned":4,"executed":4,"passed":4,"failed":0,"skipped":0}`, run with `CI_E2E_PREPARED=1` because the runner's prepare step runs `pnpm install`, which cannot run on this host (read-only pnpm store, `EROFS`)
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web test` → exit 0, `# tests 1216 / # pass 1216 / # fail 0`
- ST: not applicable — no case in the frozen ST plan covers the usage formatters.

Diffstat against `89cd2d30`: 3 files `+29/−4` (`UsagePage.tsx +7/−2`, `usageFormat.ts +4/−1`, `UsagePage.test.tsx +18/−1`). The test commit additionally exports `formatChartNumber` so the axis boundary can be pinned; it changes no behaviour on its own.

## E2E user journeys

BLOCKED: no browser journey was run against a materialised stack. The boundary is pinned by unit-level assertions over the real formatters, including both sides of it (`999_499`/`999_500`, `999_949`/`999_999`).

## Release

Release category: release:fix
User impact: token counts and chart ticks just below one million print `1.0M` rather than `1000K`/`1000.0K`, so the compact number never disagrees with the exported exact value.
Compatibility and migration: none.

recent_merged.body:
Fixes #874

## What this fixes

The API treats `unknown` as a finished-but-unverified outcome for the live surface: `services/api/src/workspace-transfers.ts:17` and `shell-executions.ts` both define terminal as *not queued and not running*, and an unfinished record found after an API restart is stored as `state: "unknown"` with `finishedAt` set and the reason it stopped being tracked.

But the API deliberately keeps one branch open for it. `services/api/src/shell-executions.ts` `cancel()`:

```ts
// Unknown after restart may still be running remotely; cancellation is safe, resubmission is not.
if (!terminal(execution.state) || execution.state === "unknown") { … }
```

The panel had a single predicate doing both jobs — `const active = (state) => ["queued", "running", "unknown"].includes(state)` (`apps/web/src/AgentActivityPanel.tsx:20`) — so an `unknown` record rendered as `process-live` forever (open body, hidden summary, never foldable history), the execution Cancel guard (`:94`) was enabled for it, while the transfer Cancel guard used a hand-written `["queued", "running"]` (`:106`) and disabled its button. The panel gave the same outcome two different answers, and neither the live surface nor the guards matched the API.

Two predicates now:

- `live = state === "queued" || state === "running"` — decides the live surface (`ProcessRecord`) and the **transfer** Cancel guard;
- `cancellable = live(state) || state === "unknown"` — used **only** by the **execution** Cancel guard, because that is exactly the branch the API keeps actionable.

So an unknown execution folds into the ordinary history record (summary row, recorded error shown) yet keeps a reachable "Cancel execution" button; an unknown transfer folds into history with Cancel disabled, because the API settles transfers itself and nothing is left running remotely.

## Red → green

Red first (`4e5369af`, test only), `cd apps/web && node --import tsx --test tests/ActivityUnknownOutcome.test.tsx`:

```
not ok 2 - an unknown record is history, yet its execution stays cancellable
  error: an unknown execution may still run remotely, so it stays cancellable
  true !== false
# tests 3 / # pass 2 / # fail 1
```

The first case also pins the split on the rendering side: of the two `details` nodes wrapping a "Cancel execution" button, `1` is `process-record` and `0` are `process-live`.

Green after the fix (`a2309d0e`): same command → `3/3 pass`.

The third case is the over-fix guard: a `running` execution and a `queued` transfer still render `process-live` (count 2) and keep both cancel buttons enabled.

History on this branch: `396bdfe0` (first fix, `unknown` fully terminal), then this review round as `4e5369af` (red) → `a2309d0e` (fix). The tip supersedes `396bdfe0`'s Cancel behaviour only; the live-surface change stands.

## Ran / Not run

Ran (exit codes verbatim):

1. `pnpm --recursive typecheck` → **0**
2. `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` → **0**
3. `cd apps/web && node --import tsx --test tests/ActivityUnknownOutcome.test.tsx` → **0** (`3/3`)
4. `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web test` → **0** (`1218 pass / 0 fail`, the whole web suite)
5. `pnpm architecture:check` (this repo has no lint script, so the architecture gate stands in) → **1**, one failure `scripts/race-contract.test.mjs`: `Could not create temporary file … /home/xuke/.cache/uv/.tmp… Read-only file system (os error 30)` — the sandbox blocks `uv`, unrelated to this diff.

Not run: the ST/E2E layer locally; CI runs it.

## Diffstat

`git diff --stat 89cd2d30…HEAD`:

```
 apps/web/src/AgentActivityPanel.tsx            | 19 ++++--
 apps/web/tests/ActivityUnknownOutcome.test.tsx | 86 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 100 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)
```

## Release

Release category: release:fix
User impact: an activity record whose outcome is unknown (the API restarted while it was unfinished) no longer renders as a permanently live, expanded record — it folds into the ordinary history entry and shows the recorded error. Its "Cancel execution" button stays enabled, matching the API, which keeps cancellation open for exactly these records because the work may still be running on a runner it restarted away from; "Cancel transfer" stays disabled for them.
Compatibility and migration: none.

Fixes #859

A zero-byte `.csv` artifact never leaves "Loading CSV Artifact": the readiness gate asked for both a loaded version **and** a non-empty source string, so an empty-but-valid version satisfied `loadedVersionId === versionId` and still failed the gate. The CSV card stayed disabled and the visualization workspace could not be opened at all, while the raw preview underneath was already showing the (empty) document.

## What changed

- `isCsvWorkspaceReady` tracks whether the immutable version arrived (`loadedVersionId === versionId`), not how many bytes it holds. Empty content is a property of the artifact, not evidence that the read is still in flight; the in-flight case is still covered because `loadedVersionId` is undefined until the read resolves.
- Nothing else changes: `csvDetection` still decides the viewer, the launch button still waits for `ready`, and the empty source reaches the existing raw preview and the workspace parser unchanged.

## Validation

Red first, on `89cd2d30`:
- `apps/web/tests/ScientificArtifacts.test.tsx` — `# tests 33 / # pass 32 / # fail 1`; `not ok 20 - a zero-byte CSV version is loaded, not still loading`, `expected: true`, `actual: false`.
- After the fix: `# tests 33 / # pass 33 / # fail 0`.

Gates at tip `750b0c37148e99d2f2493a2cbbcb9243bd0a55d7`:
- `pnpm --recursive typecheck` → exit 0
- `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` → exit 0
- `pnpm ci:l1` → exit 0, `{"status":"PASS","planned":4,"executed":4,"passed":4,"failed":0,"skipped":0}`, run with `CI_E2E_PREPARED=1` because the runner's prepare step calls `pnpm install`, unavailable on this host (read-only pnpm store, `EROFS`)
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web test` → exit 0, `# tests 1216 / # pass 1216 / # fail 0`
- ST: not applicable — no case in the frozen ST plan covers the CSV viewer gate.

Diffstat against `89cd2d30`: 2 files `+28/−1` (`ScientificArtifacts.tsx +4/−1`, `ScientificArtifacts.test.tsx +24`).

## E2E user journeys

BLOCKED: no browser journey was run against a materialised stack. The gate that kept the card disabled is pinned directly (`isCsvWorkspaceReady` with a loaded version and `source: ""` returns `true`, and still `false` before the version loads).

## Release

Release category: release:fix
User impact: a zero-byte `.csv` artifact now opens its CSV workspace instead of showing "Loading CSV Artifact" forever.
Compatibility and migration: none.

The repository-scoped development skill forces every contributor's Git author and committer to a personal account, and also carries personal claim and model-routing rules. Remove the entire personal skill so future repository skill discovery no longer loads those instructions.

Deletes only `.agents/skills/sciencediscovery-dev/SKILL.md` and its two otherwise-unreferenced supporting documents (3 files, 115 deleted lines). Existing contribution documentation and the other repository skills remain available.

Refs #851.

## Validation

- Baseline: `9dd386e5`; candidate: `77adec8388a7cc902620397a912af9bda33c805a`.
- Confirmed the baseline contains the forced identity and assignment instructions.
- Candidate contains 0 tracked files under the removed skill directory and 0 remaining tracked references to `sciencediscovery-dev`.
- `git diff --check`: passed. Commit uses the existing configured Git identity; no identity settings were changed.
- Local L1: planned 4 / executed 4 / passed 4 / failed 0 / skipped 0. Repository build passed during UT preparation.
- Local UT: BLOCKED before collection by `uv sync --project services/paper --locked` reporting that the lockfile needs updating. Reproduced the identical preparation failure on an unmodified detached checkout of baseline `9dd386e5`; no test cases executed and no lockfile changes were made.
- Local ST: attempted, then stopped during repeated build preparation after repository CI classified this instruction-only change as documentation-only. No ST cases executed. Local mocked E2E: not completed; no cases executed. An initial local CLI attempt also hit the host's Corepack dynamic-import error before the package-manager path was corrected.
- GitHub ready-for-review CI run [41833561646](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41833561646): completed successfully; L1 and merge-gate passed. The workflow's documentation-only routing skipped UT, ST, mocked E2E, Coverage, and distribution/real jobs. Skipped layers are not claimed as tested.

## E2E user journeys

Not applicable: this removes contributor instructions only; no product code, tests, runtime settings, or user-facing product behavior is changed. It does not restore Git configuration already changed on contributors' machines, rewrite past commit identities, or remove skills independently installed outside this repository. Already-running agents may retain the old instructions until a new task/session loads updated rules.

## Release

Release category: release:internal
Internal impact: removes personal workflow instructions from shared agent configuration.
